Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
I'm sure this was ruled on somewhere. Can you Cloak another vampire
from torpor? =)

Cloak the Gathering's card text:
"+1 stealth. (S) Usable by a vampire other than the acting minion. The
acting minion gets +1 stealth."

Doesn't mention "ready vampire". You CAN play it while tapped, by
previous rulings. You CAN play action modifiers while in torpor,
since you could play it at inferior while rescuing yourself. This
would seem to indicate that you could play it at superior (probably
while someone was trying to rescue you).

It would be very counterintuitive, though, and be silly. =) But it
would help my latest Stupid New Deck idea. =)

-- Derek

Deafness never kept composers from hearing the music.
It only stopped them hearing the distractions.

Right. That's to match the general ruling/errata:

* Action modifiers cannot be played by a vampire in torpor unless
that vampire is the acting minion. [RTR 06-MAR-1997]
